item.title: Red Sox Fire Cora - The Pulse of NH
item.description: The Boston Red Sox have fired manager Alex Cora, who led them to the 2018 World Series championship. item.title: Poll: Majority Disapprove Of Trump's Job Performance - The Pulse of NH
item.description: The latest UNH poll finds 60-percent of Granite Staters disapprove of President Trump’s job performance. Thirty-nine percent approve and one-percent are unsure. Trump’s approval runs along partisan lines, 82-percent of Republicans approve, but only 32-percent of independents and one-percent of Democrats. The margin of error is two-point-seven-percent.

item.title: NH: Price Of Gas Still Rising - The Pulse of NH
item.description: The price of gasoline in New Hampshire is still rising. The average price per gallon is now four-dollars-seven-cents. That’s up 15-cents from a week ago. According to Triple A the current national average is four-dollars-11-cents a gallon.

item.title: Poll: Overwhelming Opposition To An Income Tax - The Pulse of NH
item.description: A new poll shows overwhelming opposition in New Hampshire to an income tax. Asked about implementing such a tax, 71-percent are against while just 22-percent are in support.
